quarterly_data.quarter: CoreWeave press release: Ennoble Care Selects CoreWeave to Power AI Inference Across (09-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer: Ennoble Care, a home-based primary, palliative and hospice care provider operating as an accountable care organization across multiple states, selected CoreWeave Cloud to run its clinical AI inference workloads. Under the agreement Ennoble Care is deploying NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition nodes on CoreWeave Kubernetes Service (CKS) as dedicated, reserved GPU capacity, with hardware-enforced isolation and zero-trust controls. CRO Jon Jones framed clinical inference as continuous, latency-bound and compliance-heavy work. No contract value or term is stated.
quarterly_data.figure: reserved NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition nodes on CKS; no value stated
